integrity: The recent source was checked in full arXiv HTML: its record gives first submission 2026-09-28 and MSC 03C45, and Theorem 10.33 gives lovely-pair preservation for every dividing line in \(\mathfrak D^h_{n\text{-var}}\). The finite-depth coset proof was reconstructed directly. Classical dense-pair sources were checked to separate the claim from known NIP/strong-dependence preservation results.
scientific_limitations: The result proves arbitrarily large finite inp-patterns for the singleton partial type \(x=x\). It does not assert that the lovely-pair theory is not strongly dependent, does not construct one complete singleton type of infinite dp-rank, and does not classify all rank-bounded dividing lines outside Kim's framework.
title: Lovely pairs of real closed fields have unbounded unary dp-rank
